originalTitle: David Brat bound for Australia as diplomat confirmed as next US ambassador
summary: Former Republican state congressman, who once argued Christianity and capitalism should merge, confirmed by US Senate to fill long-vacant role
content: Former Virginia congressman David Brat has been confirmed by the US Senate to be the next US ambassador to Australia, after the role had been left vacant for 18 months. Brat’s confirmation was among more than 70 votes pushed through the Senate by Republicans on Friday, Washington time, before the summer recess. Brat was nominated by Donald Trump in April. The 61-year-old served two terms in Congress until 2018 when he was defeated by a Democrat, and was vice-president of business relations at Virginia’s Liberty University. The ambassador role had been vacant since November 2024, when Joe Biden’s ambassador, Caroline Kennedy, left the post. Anthony Albanese in April said he would work with anyone Trump nominated, when asked to respond to Brat’s earlier claims that US intelligence agencies conspired to remove Trump from office. “We respect the sovereignty of countries to put forward ambassadors just like we expect our choices to be endorsed,” he said at the time. Sign up for the Breaking News Australia email Brat was described by Time magazine in 2010 as a “Tea Party professor” and an enthusiast of the author Ayn Rand. In a 2011 paper, he argued that capitalism and Christianity should merge, writing: “If we all did the right thing and had the guts to spread the word, we would not need the government to backstop every action we take.” Brat was swept into the Senate in 2014 when he defeated the then House of Representatives majority leader, Eric Cantor, in a primary. He lost his seat in 2018 to Democrat Abigail Spanberger, who is now the governor of Virginia. The confirmation comes amid tense US-Australia relations, with Trump levelling 12.5% tariffs on many Australian exports in July. Australia was on a list of 54 economies hit with the tariffs due to what the US claimed was a failure “to impose and effectively enforce a prohibition on the importation of goods produced with forced labor”. At the time, the trade minister, Don Farrell, called for the tariffs to be removed, saying they were inconsistent with Australia’s free-trade agreement with the US. Brat’s arrival in Australia will coincide with the 75th anniversary of the Anzus treaty, a security pact over defence of the Pacific, and comes after the Albanese government announced in May it would instead purchase three second-hand American nuclear submarines as part of the $370bn Aukus deal, instead of two second-hand and one new as originally intended. While the Albanese government has remained supportive of Aukus, there has been growing disquiet from some within Labor about the plan. Former cabinet minister Ed Husic said in June that the change meant “we are not going to get the deal that was promised to us”. The former defence secretary Greg Moriarty has been Australia’s representative in Washington since taking over from former prime minister Kevin Rudd in April.
chineseTitle: 外交官戴维·布拉特（David Brat）将前往澳大利亚担任下一任美国大使
chineseSummary: 曾主张基督教和资本主义应该融合的前共和党州议员被美国参议院确认填补长期空缺的职位
chineseContent: 前弗吉尼亚州国会议员戴维·布拉特 (David Brat) 已被美国参议院确认为下一任美国驻澳大利亚大使，此前该职位空缺 18 个月。华盛顿时间周五夏季休会前，共和党人在参议院通过了 70 多票投票，布拉特的确认是其中之一。布拉特于四月被唐纳德·特朗普提名。这位 61 岁的总统曾在国会任职两届，直到 2018 年被民主党击败，并担任弗吉尼亚自由大学商业关系副校长。自 2024 年 11 月乔·拜登的大使卡罗琳·肯尼迪卸任以来，该大使职位一直空缺。安东尼·阿尔博内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 今年 4 月在被要求回应布拉特早些时候关于美国情报机构密谋罢免特朗普的说法时表示，他将与特朗普提名的任何人合作。他当时表示：“我们尊重各国派遣大使的主权，就像我们希望我们的选择得到认可一样。” 2010 年，《时代》杂志将 Brat 描述为“茶党教授”和作家艾因·兰德 (Ayn Rand) 的狂热爱好者。在 2011 年的一篇论文中，他认为资本主义和基督教应该融合，并写道：“如果我们都做了正确的事，并且有勇气传播信息，我们就不需要政府支持我们采取的每一项行动。” 2014 年，布拉特在初选中击败当时的众议院多数党领袖埃里克·坎托 (Eric Cantor)，进入参议院。 2018 年，他的席位输给了民主党人阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格，后者现任弗吉尼亚州州长。这一确认是在美澳关系紧张之际作出的，特朗普在 7 月份对许多澳大利亚出口产品征收了 12.5% 的关税。由于美国声称的关税措施，澳大利亚被列入 54 个受到关税打击的经济体名单中。
